title: Referral System Action Reference: Lengthening the Validity of a Visit Referral
content:
When a visit referral whose type adds units on extension — the In-Group Specialist Referral, the HMO Specialist Referral, the Out-of-Network Referral and the Physical Therapy Episode Authorization under Referrals & Prior Authorizations — is extended, its validity is lengthened by the course validity days, moving the referral's valid-through date later. The visits of the extension are posted separately, and this lengthening is not counted as an extension decision of its own.

## What the action does

One call moves the valid-through date (the last valid date) of a visit referral — a referral whose units are visits — later by the number of calendar days given. It changes only that date: the count of extensions, the latest decision, the units remaining and the provider are left unchanged. The patient can then see the new last valid date on the referral.

## How it is invoked

The action is `lengthen_referral_validity_fab859e3`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_id` | the reference number of the visit referral, as shown on the referral returned by the referral lookup for this patient | identifier, as shown |
| `added_validity_days` | the number of calendar days added to the current last valid date | a positive whole number of days, no fraction |

## Return

A successful call returns `referral_id` (the referral lengthened), `previous_valid_through` (the last valid date the referral carried until this call, written YYYY-MM-DD) and `valid_through` (the new last valid date, written YYYY-MM-DD). A returned `valid_through` later than `previous_valid_through` means success.

## Questions answered

**Does the lengthening add visits or count as an extension?** No. The visits of the extension are posted separately, and the lengthening is not counted as an extension decision of its own; the call leaves the extension count and the units remaining as they are.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** A referral last valid on 2026-06-30 lengthened with `added_validity_days` of 62 returns `previous_valid_through` 2026-06-30 and `valid_through` 2026-08-31.
